For fixed direction its exact chord representation is ∫(ell(v)-t)_+dv. At each tangency, Frenet local boundary has coefficients b2=κ/2,b3=κ_s/6,b4=(κ_ss+3κ³)/24; independent root-series reversion checked inward chord depth δ(q)=κ q²/8+[9κ^4+3κ κ_ss-5κ_s²]q^4/(1152κ)+o(q^4). Integrating δ from 0 to t and over all directions yields t³ term ∫κ²/12 and t^5 term ∫(9κ^4-8κ_s²)/2880 after Gauss map and by-parts. Radial t dt, density normalization, and equal-area radius r=ρ sqrt(A/π) give the stated ρ²,ρ³,ρ⁵,ρ⁷ coefficients, especially A^(3/2)/(20160 π^(7/2)) times the invariant. Independently evaluated ∫[9/(1+a cos kθ)^3-8k²a²sin²(kθ)/(1+a cos kθ)^5]dθ for k=2,3,4 and amplitudes 0,.2,.5,.9 and verified exact π[18-(9+8k²)a²-(9+2k²)a⁴]/(1-a²)^(7/2). Its numerator is strictly decreasing in a² and changes sign once for every k>=2; k=3,a=1/2 gives -56π/(3√3), disk ρ⁷ coefficient 1/(1120π).
